author: priya-raman
title: Idempotency key purge takes 11 minutes
body:
## Summary

The 04:00 purge of idempotency keys older than 24 hours now takes about 11 minutes and holds row locks long enough to slow the first API calls of the morning.

## Cause

It deletes in one statement. Retention is still 24 hours, as decided in issue 233, so the table is not growing; the delete is just large after busy days.

## Proposal

Delete in batches of 10,000 ordered by `created_at`, committing between batches. The index on `created_at` already exists.
